quarterly_data.quarter: Panasonic Holdings press release: Panasonic Energy Launches New Global Battery R&D Hub in (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Panasonic Energy launched Energy Innovation Square, a new lithium-ion battery R&D facility in Kadoma, Osaka (material development, cell design and prototyping; approximately 24,500 square meters, approximately 500 employees). Together with the Suminoe Production Development Facility (manufacturing technology development; combined workforce approximately 800) it is to accelerate development and mass production of next-generation batteries for automotive and data center applications, with technologies and processes deployed across its global manufacturing network including Japan and Nevada and Kansas in the US. Company target: double development efficiency by FY2031 (fiscal year ending March 2031) compared with FY2024; consolidation expected to shorten development lead times involving transportation by more than 15%. Release: the expansion of AI data centers is driving demand for higher-output batteries.
quarterly_data.figure: ~24,500 sq m, ~500 employees (~800 with Suminoe); double development efficiency by FY2031 vs FY2024; lead times shortened by more than 15%
